name: Netlify
summary: Platform for building and deploying websites.

flows.title: Add a domain alias to a site
steps: Open the site and go to its configuration settings under Domain management > Production domains.
Select Add domain alias, and follow the prompts to assign the domain to the site.
Optionally, to make an alias the primary domain, select the Options button next to it, then select Set as primary domain.

flows.title: Create a site environment variable
steps: Open the project and go to Project configuration > Environment variables.
Create the variable there individually, or import variables from a .env file.
Build and deploy the site again for the addition to take effect. A variable with the same key set in a netlify.toml file overrides the one set in the Netlify UI.
